reviewer: AI subagent guidance_acceptance; not a human participant
scope: Independent source and final receipt readback; browser interaction owned by root. No model execution, dependency installation, or edits to product and old evidence.

checks.requirement: 检查模型仅调用现有静态validate API；显示declared/static shape与not executed边界，不能声称训练、forward或runtime观察。
checks.evidence: UI/source wording; api endpoint; backend no-execution contract; root actual browser evidence.

checks.requirement: 成功结果和错误响应必须绑定请求semantic key及当前draft identity，过时异步响应不得覆盖新语义。
checks.evidence: semantic-key helper and integration response guard; meaningful tests with changed semantic snapshot.

checks.requirement: 未连完整图和shape错误仍可编辑；仅已登记且唯一node/parameter/port可定位。
checks.evidence: validation issue parser; feedback resolver; UI targeting and editing controls; browser invalid/incomplete graph evidence.

checks.requirement: 仅移动、显示名、title变化保留适用的静态shape；参数、kind、node或edge语义变化使其失效；undo/redo也不能显示不适用的结果。
checks.evidence: semantic projection tests; integrated derived validation state; browser move/label/parameter/edge and history evidence.

checks.requirement: hover/focus端口提示以viewport像素可读，缩放不缩小字号；不得改变canonical端点、命中区域、peer归属或遮挡点击。
checks.evidence: tooltip placement/source/CSS; unchanged portPoint; pointer-events:none; hit-neighbor geometry tests; browser hover/focus at two zooms.

checks.requirement: 新参数中文解释保持原catalog key/值/提交逻辑；Escape恢复有效值且提示与事实相符。
checks.evidence: parameter helper coverage and UI aria/help integration; DraftField restore/blur flow; browser invalid-escape evidence.

checks.requirement: 检查、显示shape、hover/focus、取消提示不得移动用户节点或建立history项。
checks.evidence: source control-flow review and before/after semantic/layout/history assertions from available tests/browser evidence.

checks.requirement: 最终源文件与测试/build receipt绑定当前字节；原始浏览器截图和DOM范围明确，AI证据不可提升为真人或presentation性能认证。
checks.evidence: exact input hashes, stdout/exit checks and relevant artifact readback; bounded report.

preliminaryRisks: Current baseline boot validate discards successful tensors; final explicit check must retain only results applicable to current semantic identity.

Backend validate normalizes defaults and contains revision/title/layout in draftDigest; frontend shape validity must derive independently from shape semantics, not use full draftDigest equality for movement.
Backend issues may use nodeIds (unused-node) or portIds (unbound-input); parser must not manufacture a unique target or lose explanatory issues.
DraftField baseline Escape restores text but baseline footer still describes only invalid input; revised notices must remain accurate through React blur/state timing.
